concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-adyen-reconciliation]] - Braintree-hosted Settlement Details Report route for merchants whose transactions are processed with Adyen, covering permission-gated access, per-MID reports, payout and transaction references, and reserve, fee, invoice and batch-transfer adjustment locators; not independent Adyen authority or proof of an individual bank deposit
warnings: Keep this processor-specific Braintree article separate from the C33 PayPal Orchestration Adyen integration guide and from independent Adyen documentation.
The report's payout and deposit-matching fields do not prove that a particular payout settled or reached a bank account; the pricing scenario is an example conditioned on an agreement.
